description: The file defines a PHP class MailingCommand that extends an abstract command class for the Symfony Console component. It configures and implements a console command for sending massive email mailings, handling process control, rate limiting, locking, and mailing status updates.

classes.name: MailingCommand
classes.description: Defines a console command for processing and sending massive email mailings, including rate limiting, process control, and mailing status management.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the console command name, description, arguments, options, and help message.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the mailing process, handling locking, rate control, process spawning, and error management for massive email dispatch.
